observations.title: Find a control by its action name
observations.player_action: Open Key Binds and type part of an action's name in the search.
observations.outcome: The list narrows to matching keybindings.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Find conflicting and available keys
observations.player_action: Use the conflict filter and inspect available keys before rebinding an action.
observations.outcome: Duplicate bindings can be isolated and replaced with an unused key.
conditions: The Left Control screen shortcut shown for 1.10.2 is historical and must not be presented as the installed 1.20.1 control.
